name: Share India Securities Ltd
title: Share India Securities Ltd - 540725 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 standalone PAT up 368% to INR 75 crore on prop/MTF growth, but management concedes RBI curbs on intraday prop limits could cut limits ~20%, and no capacity or supply discipline is discussed.

triggers.label: RBI bars intraday limits for prop
triggers.quote: RBI has disallowed the banks to provide any intraday limits.

triggers.label: MTF book target INR 650 crore FY27
triggers.quote: target for MTF book is INR 650 odd crores by FY27

triggers.label: Q4 PAT INR 75 cr vs INR 16 cr
triggers.quote: Profit after tax increased significantly to INR 75 crore as against INR 16 crore

guidance.value: at least INR 500 crore by FY27

red_flags.label: RBI curbs on prop intraday limits
red_flags.quote: RBI has disallowed the banks to provide any intraday limits.

red_flags.label: Consolidated PAT down YoY on FY basis
red_flags.quote: profit after tax on a consolidated basis stood at INR 324 crore compared with INR 328 crore

red_flags.label: Prop still ~50% of profit
red_flags.quote: the usual number what it currently is around 50%
